title: Fix the Method Missing a Return Path
description: The program should classify a number's sign and return a description string.
expectedBehavior: The program should compile and print 'positive' for describe(5).
actualProblem: The method has no return statement for the case where n is exactly 0, so not every code path returns a value. The compiler rejects this with 'missing return statement'.
explanation: A Java method declared to return a value must guarantee a return on every possible execution path. Adding the missing else branch (for n == 0) ensures the method always returns something.
